about.title: Security-focused engineer · Full Stack Developer
paragraphs: Security-focused engineer with over 3 years of professional experience in vulnerability management, security incident response, and secure identity management, along with full-stack development and backend automation. I am a Full Stack Developer on contract with Amiseq (client: Nutanix). I build Python data pipelines for the Wiz platform, track vulnerability trends and emergency patch status for zero-day vulnerabilities, and support SAST, SCA, and CSPM assessments with Harbor, Wiz, Tenable, and Black Duck.
I hold ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), Okta Professional, and the SailPoint Identity Security Leader credential. I also completed the Microsoft Entra ID course on LinkedIn Learning.
Apart from code, I'm a GearHead.

certificationsNote: 4 Applause Awards for engineering performance and prompt bug resolutions during tenure at Deloitte
